mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM REP_REVEAL WHERE STATUS = 'E'
(REP_ID = #{item.repId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PRODID = #{item.prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND DATE_FORMAT(END_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = #{item.endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

select #{repId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as repId,/** 报表ID**/ p.PROD_ID as prodId,/** 产品代码**/ p.PROD_NAME as prodName,/** 产品名称**/ concat_ws('',p.PROD_NAME,'(', p.PROD_ID,')') as prodIdName, /** 产品名称 + 代码**/ #{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as endDate, /** 结束日期*/ #{startDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as startDate, /** 开始日期*/ case when l.PRODID is null then '未生成' else '已生成' end as createStatus, l.CONFIRM_STATUS as confirmStatus, /** 确认状态*/ l.CREATE_TIME as createTime /** 生成时间**/ from CHB_PRD_BASEINFO p left join ( select max(d.SETTDATE_DATE) as SETTDATEDATE, d.PROD_ID from CHB_PRD_DEAL d where d.`STATUS` = 'E' and d.TRADE_TYPE = '16' group by d.PROD_ID ) r on r.PROD_ID = p.PROD_ID left join REP_REVEAL l on l.REP_ID = #{repId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and l.`STATUS` = 'E' and l.PRODID = p.PROD_ID and DATE_FORMAT(l.END_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = #{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and DATE_FORMAT(l.START_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') = #{startDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where p.`STATUS` = 'E' /** 产品未终止**/ and (r.SETTDATEDATE is null or DATE_FORMAT(r.SETTDATEDATE,'%Y-%m-%d') > #{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) /** 到期日 - 当前日期 大于 90**/ and (p.MDATE is null or TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d'), p.MDATE) >= 90) /** 当前日期 - 成立日 大于 90**/ and (TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, p.VDATE, STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d')) >= 90) and ifnull(l.CONFIRM_STATUS, '0') = '0' /** 未确认的数据**/
and p.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
